compiler_finding.observation_in_placed_ir: in the hanging builds each shim-side output get requests [1,256,128] with a different offset per column in the head dimension and one row offset; the working builds request [1,128,128] with the head fixed per group and row offsets varying
compiler_finding.inference_not_traced_on_device: the pass applies its split offset to the head dimension instead of the row dimension and does not shrink the transfer size, so the shim waits for data that is never sent
compiler_finding.workaround: allocate every L2 buffer with air.alloc(split=False) and split the Q and output L2 buffers explicitly per herd column (--no-split --q-split 2 --out-split 2 --split-axis column)

patched_node_files_note: The harness imports a session-patched copy of the deployed node. Against the deployed node it carries the host AdaLN and lightweight finite-check patches documented earlier; the only change made for this experiment is AttentionShape.query_cores in (4, 8). The repository head differs from the deployed node in other respects (it has no ANIMA_XDNA_GEMM_LAYOUT_DIR handling in chain.py), so its line counts include unrelated differences. Both diffs are in the archive.
limitations: Outputs equal the production ELF bit for bit on the tested inputs and across the three sampler modes; this is not a claim about image quality against the BF16 model, and the INT8 baseline already differs from it.
Absolute sampler medians drift between sessions (the pinned mode measured 6.994, 7.188 and 7.086 s in different runs); modes are compared only inside one A/B with rotated order and paired deltas.
Eight runs per mode with eight of eight negative paired deltas; no statistical test was run.
Sampler medians exclude the VAE, loading, text encoding and saving; every VAE-inclusive figure is an estimate from separate measurements, not a timed end-to-end run.

The NPU slow state is measured (slow over fast device time x1.30 to x1.37 on 8 of 9 builds; self/pp-k1024 gave x1.21 because its three fast-state phases measured 5.32, 6.45, 6.27 ms, an unexplained drift); its attribution to clock or power management is a hypothesis, not a clock reading.
The air-split-l2-memref cause is read from compiler output and the working workaround; it was not traced on the device and no upstream fix was tested.
The nq=8 artifacts need AttentionShape.query_cores in (4, 8), changed only in the session-patched node copy; the repository and the production install are unchanged.
The two-mode ping-pong A/B ran with an earlier int8_e2e_air.py (before the nq8pp mode was added); its pinned hash no longer matches the file.
